summary: Implemented the S3 Expires customization in botocore. Changes: botocore/model.py adds _add_expires_string_member, called from OperationModel.output_shape. For output structures with a timestamp Expires member, it marks Expires as deprecated in its documentation and adds a synthetic ExpiresString string member that reads the same Expires header. botocore/parsers.py makes BaseRestParser parse an Expires header leniently: if parsing fails, the key is omitted and a warning is logged, and the raw value remains available via ExpiresString. Added changelog entry .changes/next-release/enhancement-S3-expires.json. Nothing was committed. Tests were not run, per the instructions; the changes were verified by reading only. Note: the fallback applies to any rest-protocol header member named Expires with timestamp type, not only S3.
